title: A lake lasted 700 years, then filled itself in #Shorts
description:
A lake that lasted seven hundred years, then filled itself in. When a mountainside fell into Zion Canyon, it dammed the Virgin River, and a lake some call Lake Zion filled the valley. Then the river slowly buried it, dropping sand and mud into the still water, until about four thousand one hundred years ago the lake was full. Not of water. Of sediment. That's the flat floor of Zion Canyon today.

▶ Full documentary (Zion, Part 2: The Day the Mountain Fell: Zion's Lost Lake): https://youtu.be/1KUANk1uGtU

#Shorts #Zion #Geology #History #NationalParks
